Maya (CS): Quick flag - CedarStream ran an int8 pilot and noticed intermittent p99 spikes for long summary jobs. p95 is fine.
Theo (SRE): Any config changes before spike?
Maya (CS): They increased max_context for summaries to 600 tokens and switched to compact-int8 last night.
Rina (ML): int8 + long context often hits KV churn and occasional slow kernels.
Theo (SRE): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) route >400 token requests to fp16 fallback, 2) enable prefix KV caching for summary endpoint, 3) run a 3% fp16 canary for 20m.
Maya (CS): Can you share a tiny override snippet I can paste to the customer?
Theo (SRE): Snippet:
```
routing:
  rules:
    - when: request.tokens > 400
      route_to: redwood/fp16-latency-opt
cache:
  prefix_kv_enabled: true
```
Rina (ML): Also capture 50 samples from each path to check for quantization regressions.
Maya (CS): Draft message to customer: "Please enable prefix KV for summaries and apply the routing override. We'll run a short 20m fp16 canary at 15:10 PT and report p95/p99 and sample outputs."
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @Theo (SRE) for cedarstream-prod routing override (job 12357).
Maya (CS): I'll log this in onboarding tracker and watch renewal-risk until canary completes. Will update thread when done.
